texts.setting.machine.description: Which computer this is: the 128K Pentagon (128 BASIC, TR-DOS, AY sound) or the 48K Spectrum (48 BASIC). A snapshot file says which machine it was taken on, and that machine is used whatever is chosen here. The choice is recorded in the project, so movies replay on the same machine.
texts.setting.fast_tape.description: Trap the ROM tape loader (dec/djnz delay loops and edge waits) instead of executing it, while a tape runs. Upstream default; off is cycle-exact loading. Shapes the machine, so it is a sync setting.
texts.setting.sound_chip.description: AY-3-8910 or its Yamaha YM2149F pin-compatible follow-up (different volume tables). Shapes the machine, so it is a sync setting.
texts.firmware.sos128_0.description: Pentagon 128K BASIC ROM (page 0). The machine does not boot without it.
texts.firmware.sos128_1.description: Pentagon 128K editor/menu ROM (page 1). The machine does not boot without it.
texts.firmware.sos48.description: 48K BASIC ROM, selected at boot by the 48K machine (always loaded; the machine exits without any of the five).
texts.firmware.service.description: Service/test ROM, selected at boot when not in 48K mode. The machine does not boot without it.
texts.firmware.dos513f.description: TR-DOS ROM for the Beta Disk interface. Needed for disk images.
texts.slot.game.title: Spectrum software
texts.slot.game.help: The tape or snapshot to boot: TAP/TZX/CSW tapes and SNA/Z80/SZX snapshots, or a ZIP holding one of those.
